output.content: The nightly batch job pulls raw point of sale scan lines and stock on hand records directly from the warehouse systems. Each model retraining run recalculates every derived metric from scratch, reading the same historical tables repeatedly. There is no shared layer holding precomputed features. When the promotion allocation script needs article price history or store size, it queries the source databases again. The data pipelines handle the extraction and transformation, but nothing persists the results for reuse across the daily forecast and the weekly buyer allocation runs.
